appearance.skinModernDetail: Rubutu mai faɗi daban-daban, hotuna da layuka masu faɗi

display.heading: Nuni (wannan na'ura)
display.fontSizeNote: Girman rubutu na kowace na'ura ne — ba zai daidaita zuwa sauran na'urorinku ba.
display.fontSizeSample: Wani ɗan farin zomo ya tsallake kare mai ƙiwuya.
display.callRingtoneDescription: Yana kunna ƙara mai maimaituwa a wannan na'ura idan wani ya kira. Kashe shi a nan ba ya kashe alamar sanarwa ko sauran na'urorinku.

layout.heading: Tsari
layout.sidebarDescription: Yana sarrafa ko labarun gefe na hagu zai kasance a buɗe idan manhajar ta fara. Kunna ko kashe shi a kowane lokaci da {{shortcut}}.
layout.rightPanelDescription: Mambobi da kafofin da aka raba na tasha ko tattaunawar da ake kallo. Ana tunawa da shi a wannan na'ura don asusunku — yana zama yadda aka bar shi yayin da ake zagayawa cikin manhajar, kuma ba ya bin ku zuwa sauran na'urorinku. Kunna ko kashe shi a kowane lokaci da {{shortcut}}.
layout.closeToTrayDescription: Idan yana kunne, rufe taga yana ɓoye Pollis a tiren tsarin maimakon rufe shi gaba ɗaya. Danna dama a alamar tire don rufewa. Idan muhallin teburinku ba ya nuna alamomin tire (GNOME ba tare da ƙarin AppIndicator ba), kashe wannan.
layout.menubarIconDescription: Yana ƙara alamar Pollis a sandar menu ta macOS (sama dama). Danna ta don buɗe taga, kashe makirofo yayin kira, ko rufe manhajar. A kashe take a asali — alamar dock tana sa Pollis ya kasance a kusa idan taga a rufe take.

notifications.heading: Sanarwa
notifications.callTakeoverLabel: Kira masu shigowa a cikakken allo
notifications.callTakeoverDescription: Idan wani ya kira ku a DM, kiran yana mamaye allo da Karɓa da Ƙi, sannan ya mayar da ku inda kuke. A kashe: faɗakarwar sandar matsayi, ƙara da sanarwa suna zuwa kamar yadda aka saba.

readReceipts.heading: Shaidar karantawa
readReceipts.description: A saƙonnin kai tsaye, yana bar wa mutanen da kuke tattaunawa da su su ga lokacin da saƙonninsu suka isa na'urarku da lokacin da kuka karanta su. Kashe wannan kuma yana ɓoye shaidun nasu daga gare ku — ba za ku ƙara ganin ko saƙonninku sun isa ko an karanta su ba. An ɓoye shaidun daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe kamar kowane saƙo; sabarmu ba ta taɓa ganin wanda ya karanta me ba. Tashoshin rukuni ba sa taɓa aika shaida.

retention.heading: Tarihin saƙonni a cikin na'ura
retention.ariaLabel: Riƙe tarihin saƙonni a cikin na'ura
retention.description: Yana sarrafa yawan tarihin saƙonnin da ake riƙewa a wannan na'ura. Ana goge tsofaffin saƙonni daga ma'adanar na'ura don adana wuri. Wannan ba ya shafar sauran na'urorinku ko mutanen da kuke tattaunawa da su, kuma za ku ci gaba da karɓar sababbin saƙonni kamar yadda aka saba.

overlay.heading: Sirrin hanyar sadarwa (relay)
overlay.ariaLabel: Yanayin relay na sirrin hanyar sadarwa
overlay.description: Yana tura zirga-zirgar Pollis (saƙonni, daidaitawa) ta hanyar relay don sabarmu ta ga adireshin relay, ba naku ba. Kira suna haɗuwa kai tsaye. Wannan yana ɓoye IP ɗinku daga Pollis — ba ɓoye kai ba ne gaba ɗaya, kuma ba ya canja ɓoyewa daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe.
overlay.itemOff: <mode>A kashe</mode> — Haɗi kai tsaye (na asali, mafi sauri).
overlay.itemPrefer: <mode>Fifita</mode> — Yi amfani da relay idan akwai shi; koma haɗi kai tsaye idan babu.
overlay.itemStrict: <mode>Tsantsa</mode> — Haɗa ta hanyar relay kawai. Idan babu relay da za a iya isa gare shi, ana dakatar da aikawa maimakon bayyana IP ɗinku.
overlay.applyError: Ba a iya amfani da yanayin relay ba: {{error}} — a yanzu {{mode}}.

relayServing.heading: Gudanar da relay don wasu
relayServing.intro: Zaɓi ne dabam da saitin da ke sama. Wancan yana yanke ko zirga-zirgar <dim>ku</dim> za ta bi ta relay. Wannan yana yanke ko zirga-zirgar <dim>wasu mutane</dim> za ta bi ta <dim>na'urarku</dim>. Kunna ɗaya ba ya taɓa kunna ɗayan.
relayServing.enabledLabel: Tura zirga-zirga don sauran masu amfani da Pollis
relayServing.enabledDescription: A kashe yake sai dai idan kun kunna shi. Kuna iya sake kashe shi a kowane lokaci.
relayServing.wouldDoHeading: Abin da na'urarku za ta yi
relayServing.wouldDoBody: Tana tura zirga-zirgar wasu mutane da aka riga aka ɓoye zuwa sabobin Pollis kansu, don waɗannan sabobin su ga adireshinku don wannan zirga-zirgar maimakon nasu. Na'urarku tana turawa zuwa sabobin Pollis ne kawai — ba zuwa na wani ba, kuma ba zuwa buɗaɗɗen intanet ba.
relayServing.wouldSeeHeading: Abin da na'urarku za ta gani
relayServing.wouldSeeBody: Babu komai. Turawa ba ya ba da damar karanta komai. Abin da ke wucewa rafin bayanai ne da aka rufe wanda na'urarku ba ta da maɓallinsa: ba za ku iya karanta saƙonni, fayiloli ko kira ba, ba za ku iya ganin wanda ya aika su ko wanda aka aika wa ba, kuma ba za ku iya bambanta wani nau'in zirga-zirga da wani ba. Abin da na'urarku ke sani kawai shi ne wani mai amfani da Pollis yana musayar ɓoyayyun bayanai da sabar Pollis. Haka kuma ba za ku iya canja komai a hanya ba — taɓa bayanan yana katse haɗin ne kawai, kuma mai aikawa yana bin wata hanya dabam.
relayServing.costBody: Bandwidth, kuma — ba tare da sharuɗɗan da ke ƙasa ba — batir da data mai mita.
relayServing.exactBody: A faɗi daidai abin da turawa ke bayarwa: yana ɓoye adireshin IP daga sabobinmu. Shi ke nan. Ba ɓoye kai ba ne gaba ɗaya, ba kariya ba ne daga wanda zai iya kallon ɓangarorin biyu na haɗi, kuma ba ya ɓoye wanda ke magana da wane — sabobinmu suna ganin hakan daga asusun da ke yin buƙatar, da relay ko babu. Haka kuma ba shi ne ke sa Pollis ya zama an ɓoye daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe ba: ana ɓoye saƙonninku a na'urar da ke aikawa ko akwai mai gudanar da relay ko babu. Turawa kariya ce ta metadata a ƙarƙashin wannan tabbaci, ba ta taɓa zama hujjarsa ba.
relayServing.wifiOnlyDescription: Yana dakatar da turawa a data ta waya, ko a duk wani haɗi da na'urarku ta bayyana a matsayin mai mita. A kunne yake a asali.
relayServing.powerOnlyDescription: Yana dakatar da turawa yayin da wannan na'ura ke aiki da batir. A kunne yake a asali.
relayServing.statusUnreportable: wannan ginin ba zai iya bayyana matsayin relay ba, don haka Pollis ba zai iya tabbatar da ko wannan na'ura tana turawa ba.
relayServing.statusUnsupported: turawa ba ya samuwa a wannan na'ura.
relayServing.statusServing_one: ana turawa — ana ɗaukar haɗi {{count}}, an tura {{bytes}} tun da Pollis ya fara.
relayServing.statusServing_other: ana turawa — ana ɗaukar haɗi {{count}}, an tura {{bytes}} tun da Pollis ya fara.

relayServing.holdOnBattery: an dakatar — ana aiki da batir
relayServing.holdOffline: an dakatar — babu haɗin hanyar sadarwa
relayServing.holdNoInboundPath: an dakatar — sauran na'urori ba za su iya isa ga wannan ba ta hanyar sadarwarku
relayServing.signals: Wannan na'ura tana bayyana: Wi-Fi {{wifi}}, caji {{power}}.
relayServing.applyError: Ba a iya amfani da wannan a manhajar da ke gudana ba: {{error}}. An adana zaɓinku kuma zai fara aiki da zarar an isa ga sabis na relay.

security.eventIdentityResetDetail: Kun sake saita asusunku. An raba duk na'urori da rukunonin da suka gabata da asusun.
security.eventIdentityRotatedHeading: An canja maɓallin shaida na asusu
security.eventIdentityRotatedDetailSession: An ƙirƙiri sabuwar shaidar asusu daga na'urar da ba a shiga ba ta amfani da lambar imel. An cire duk na'urori da rukunonin da suka gabata.
security.eventIdentityRotatedDetailSignature: An ƙirƙiri sabuwar shaidar asusu daga ɗaya daga cikin na'urorinku da aka yi wa rajista.
security.eventSecretKeyRotatedDetail: An canja Maɓallin Sirri. Tsohon ba ya aiki kuma.
security.eventEmailChangedDetail: Asusun ya koma daga {{from}} zuwa {{to}}. Sai da adiresoshin biyu suka tabbatar da hakan.
security.eventEmailChangedDetailUnknown: An canja adireshin imel na wannan asusu.
security.accountKeyDescription: Ana wallafa maɓallin shaida a cikin rajista ta jama'a wadda ake ƙara mata kawai, don kowa ya iya tabbatar da cewa abokan hulɗa suna magana da ku na gaske. Wannan yana duba ko rajistar ta yi daidai da maɓallin da ke wannan na'ura.
security.accountKeyStatusOk: An tantance maɓalli a bainar jama'a
security.buildStatusVerified: An tantance ginin a bainar jama'a
security.buildStatusMismatch: Ginin ba ya cikin rajista ta jama'a
security.buildVerifyGuideLink: Yadda za a tantance wannan ginin da kanku →
security.thisBuildDescription: Kowace saki da Pollis ke fitarwa ana sanya mata zanen yatsa a cikin wannan rajista ta jama'a wadda ake ƙara mata kawai. Wannan yana tabbatar da cewa ginin da kuke amfani da shi ɗaya ne daga cikin waɗanda Pollis ya wallafa a can; ana kuma sake gina sakin Linux daga tushe da kansa kuma a kwatanta su da ita. Shi kaɗai ba ya tabbatar da cewa ginin ya dace da tushen, domin manhajar da aka yi wa kutse na iya yin ƙarya game da zanen yatsanta.
security.buildVerifyError: Ba a iya duba wannan ginin a yanzu ba. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.
security.pinDescription: PIN na cikin na'ura yana buɗe Pollis a wannan na'ura. Ba ya taɓa barin na'urar kuma ba za a iya dawo da shi ba — yi amfani da Maɓallin Sirri idan an manta da shi.
security.autoLockDescription: A mayar da Pollis zuwa allon PIN bayan wani lokaci ba tare da aikin linzami ko madannai ba, don kada barin wannan na'ura ya bar tattaunawarku da aka buɗe ɓoyewarsu a kan allo. Ana iya kullewa nan take a kowane lokaci da {{shortcut}}.
security.autoLockAriaLabel: Kullewa da kansa bayan rashin aiki
security.autoLockNote: Yana shafar wannan na'ura kawai. Kira da ke gudana yana barin Pollis a buɗe — kullewa zai rufe rumbun bayanai na cikin na'ura a tsakiyar kiran. Babu abin da ke ɓacewa idan ya kulle: saƙonninku suna kan faifai, kuma shigar da PIN yana mayar da ku kai tsaye.
security.devicesDescription: Kowace na'ura da aka shiga asusunku da ita. Janye izinin duk wadda ba ku gane ba — na'urar tana rasa damar shiga duk rukunoni da DM a daidaitawarta ta gaba.
security.devicesLoadFailed: Ba a iya loda na'urori ba
security.devicesEmpty: Babu na'urorin da aka yi wa rajista.
security.revokeConfirmPrompt: A janye izinin <name>{{device}}</name>? Ba za a iya mayar da wannan ba.
security.revokeFailed: Ba a iya janye izinin na'ura ba
security.eventsDescription: Duk lokacin da aka ƙara na'ura cikin asusunku, aka janye izinin na'ura, aka ƙi rajista, ko aka sake saita shaidarku, yana bayyana a nan. Duba shi idan kuna zargin wani ya shiga asusunku.
security.eventsLoadFailed: Ba a iya loda abubuwan tsaro ba
security.eventsEmpty: Ba a rubuta wani abin tsaro ba tukuna.
security.revokeMediaOnExitLabel: Janye izinin tsarin idan Pollis ya rufe
security.revokeMediaOnExitDescription: Idan yana kunne, Pollis yana share izinin kyamara / makirofo / allo da ya adana yayin rufewa, don tsarin aiki ya sake tambaya a gaba.
security.revokeNowNote: Wannan yana share izinin da Pollis ya adana.
security.mediaNoteMac: Yana share izinin da Pollis ya adana; macOS zai sake tambaya a gaba da aka yi amfani da kowane fasali.
security.mediaNoteLinux: Linux yana ba da izinin kafofi a kowane zama — Pollis ba ya adana izini na dindindin, don haka babu abin da za a janye a nan.
security.mediaNoteWindows: Matsayin kyamara da makirofo yana fitowa daga saitunan sirri na Windows. “Janye yanzu” yana buɗe waɗannan saituna don a kashe Pollis; ba a bin diddigin raba allo a can.
security.mediaNoteOther: Sarrafa izinin kafofi ba ya samuwa a wannan dandali.
security.terminalEnabledDescription: A kashe yake a asali. Idan aka kunna, allon tasha-umarni zai iya fara shell ɗin shiga da cikakken muhallinku — iko ɗaya da buɗe Terminal da kanku. A bar shi a kashe sai dai idan kuna amfani da shi.
security.exportDescription: Adana duk abin da wannan na'ura ke riƙe da shi (saƙonni, abubuwan da aka adana, ma'ajiya) zuwa fayil. Babu abin da ake ɗorawa.
security.exportNote: Kowace na'ura tana riƙe da tarihinta, don haka a yi fitar da bayanai daga wadda ke da shi.
security.exportFailed: Fitar da bayanai bai yi nasara ba
security.exportFetchNote: Wasu abubuwan haɗawa ba sa wannan na'ura. Sauke su yana ɗauko kowanne daga sabar — matakin da kawai ke amfani da intanet a nan.
security.exportFetchButton_one: Sauke abin haɗawa da ya ɓace…
security.exportFetchButton_other: Sauke abubuwan haɗawa {{count}} da suka ɓace…
security.dangerZoneDescription: Goge asusunku da duk bayanan da ke da alaƙa da shi har abada. Ba za a iya mayar da wannan ba.
security.deleteAccountFailed: Ba a iya goge asusu ba

diagnostics.intro: Rikodin abin da Pollis ya yi a wannan na'ura, kamar shiga, matsalolin haɗi da kurakurai. Idan wani abu ya lalace, raba shi yana taimaka mana gano dalili.
